class.name: NNHTNArgumentReference
class.brief_description: Resource that computes a dynamic argument for an [NNHTNSubtaskCall] from arguments or world state.
class.description: Assign to entries in [member NNHTNSubtaskCall.argument_bindings] when a reusable task call needs an argument value pulled dynamically from the current arguments ([constant ARGUMENT]) or predicted world state ([constant WORLD_STATE]), optionally following a nested dictionary [member field_path]. [codeblock] var reference := NNHTNArgumentReference.new() reference.source = NNHTNArgumentReference.WORLD_STATE reference.key = "selected_coin" reference.field_path = "target.name" call.argument_bindings["target"] = reference [/codeblock]

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns configuration error messages for this reference, or an empty array if valid.

members.member: Optional dot-separated path of [Dictionary] keys inside the value of [member key] (for example, [code]"target.position"[/code]). Leave empty to use the value directly.
Argument name or world-state blackboard key to read.
Whether to read [member key] from the call's arguments ([constant ARGUMENT]) or from the predicted world state ([constant WORLD_STATE]).

constants.constant: Reads from the call's inherited arguments, [member NNHTNSubtaskCall.args], and earlier bindings.
Reads from the predicted world state during planning and registers [member key] as a replanning trigger.
